findings.issue: Provenance note only; no correction needed. The numerical Faraday constant and the added charge calculation are standard/derived chemistry rather than facts explicitly supplied in this topic’s sources.
findings.evidence: F ≈ 96,485 C per mole of electrons is correct. Plating 1 mol Cu from Cu²⁺ requires 2 mol electrons, giving q ≈ 192,970 C, correctly rounded to 1.93 × 10⁵ C.
